metric: The benchmark's correctness-gated optimization quality (runtime speedup plus credit for a simpler statement; unsafe, non-executable and unchanged cases score 0) averaged over all 180 cases. The benchmark's own reference rewrites score 40.4 on the same setup.
correctness: 0 behaviour-changing rewrites: each rewrite is proven equivalent before it is emitted, then executed against the original on PostgreSQL 16 and compared row by row (in order when the query has ORDER BY); 0 unsafe, 0 non-executable
usefulness: 142 queries changed, 142 verified; 54 at least 10% faster, 1 slower than 0.9x (ROBUST-028, 0.75x); statements 20% smaller on average (the benchmark's SCS)
performance: Median of 5 alternating runs after a warm-up, TPC-DS and DSB at scale factor 1 on PostgreSQL 16; geometric-mean speedup 1.90x over the 142 rewrites. Per pool CGOQ: PERF 81.0, PG-AWARE 18.8, ROBUST 15.8, EQUIV 10.1
held_out: CGOQ 27.61 on the 35 held-out cases (numbers 4, 9, 14, ... in each pool, never inspected while writing rules)
command: python tools/rewrite_bench.py --bench benchmark --method kumosql --cost --jobs 3 --db tpcds_sf10=tpcds --db dsb=dsb
caveats: Scale factor 1 instead of the benchmark's 10, so speedups differ from the paper's machine; the reference score (40.4, paper 41.0) was timed without alternating runs. The release is a development split; held-out cases are this repo's own split. First run: 28.69.
